hypothesis: Preserving the fixed ordered structure of all 11 pre-aggregation bilateral activity representations until the decision stage may recover discriminative cross-activity structure lost by the single subject embedding.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain only if BA improves by at least 0.01, AUROC by at least 0.015, Macro-F1 does not decrease, neither class recall is materially sacrificed, about 10 of 15 matched splits improve, and seed stability does not worsen.
